sentiment.reason_en: The VIX sits at 17.71 (+2.97%), staying below the 18 threshold, indicating a defensive but not panic market. The S&P 500 fell to 7,551.81 (-0.45%) and the DXY is marginally weaker at 100.28 (-0.03%). Brent oil is down (-0.57%) and gold slipped (-1.23%). Ongoing war in Iran, highlighted by energy articles, adds inflationary pressure, pushing sentiment toward risk‑off. The mix of low VIX, negative equity and geopolitical conflict yields a score of 3/10.
